intro: Go'Shek Farm is an agricultural outpost in the eastern Arathi Highlands, occupied by the Horde and guarded by orcs from Hammerfall. Behind its mundane rural facade, Forsaken apothecaries conduct secretive alchemical experiments far from prying eyes.

sections.t: A Horde Outpost in the East
p: Go'Shek Farm is held by the Horde. Positioned south of Hammerfall and just north of the hostile Witherbark troll territory, the farmstead nominally serves as a vital supply and staging hub for the orcish settlement. Hammerfall Grunts patrol the fields and stables, securing food and livestock to sustain the Horde's embattled foothold in the Arathi Highlands.
